newsitem.title: USA: Whitehall gets 99 pct of Integrated Living.
newsitem.headline: Whitehall gets 99 pct of Integrated Living.

text.p: Whitehall Street Real Estate LP VII said Thursday shareholders of Integrated Living Communities Inc had tendered 99 percent of their shares to the company for $11.50 a share in cash.
Whitehall said Integrated Living shareholders tendered 6.6 million shares, or 99.2 percent of all outstanding shares, as of Wednesday.

The real estate investment fund, an affiliate of Goldman, Sachs & Co, said it plans to merge its SLC Acquisition affiliate with Integrated Living by July 9. Integrated Living shareholders who did not tender their shares will receive $11.50 a share in cash, Whitehall said.
